items.name: RankSpot
items.tagline: Pay-as-you-go SEO and AI Search execution layer for agents
items.description: RankSpot is the SEO and AI Search execution layer for agents. Connect the MCP to Claude or ChatGPT in 2 minutes and your agent does the work: it writes articles from what already ranks on Google in 100+ languages, publishes them, and pitches ranking sites from your mailbox for backlinks. Run every client or business from one chat. No subscription: $3 an article, $0.004 a prompt check, reading your data free. Start with $1 of credit and a free article.

items.name: TheBold
items.tagline: Turn execution into meetings with investors
items.description: TheBold turns startup execution into direct investor access. 🎉 Launch Fast Track (Nov 17–27): pass one AI investor-readiness interview, land in the deal flow of investors who match your startup, and unlock direct meeting access. TheBold helps founders understand investor criteria, track and verify execution and traction, practice investor-specific AI simulations, and book meetings once qualified.

items.name: Creatify Max
items.tagline: Your ad teammate, from strategy to creation to launch
items.description: Max is your teammate for paid ads. Share a product URL or brief and Max makes video ads, sets up campaigns on Meta and TikTok, and watches results 24/7, flagging what to fix next. You make the calls: nothing goes live without your approval.

items.name: Appxiom
items.tagline: Context layer for AI coding agents to detect & fix bugs
items.description: Appxiom gives your coding agent the production context it lacks: crashes, freezes, memory leaks, failed network calls and broken user journeys in mobile and web applications. Goal Friction Impact lets agents prioritise bugs by the goals they cost you. Supports Android (Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Java), iOS (Swift, SwiftUI, Objective-C), Flutter, Kotlin Multiplatform and Web (all JavaScript / TypeScript frameworks, with special support for React).

items.name: EkLine
items.tagline: AI SEO for Developer Tools and API first companies!
items.description: Your buyers ask ChatGPT which tool to use, then ask Cursor to build with it. EkLine helps your API or developer tool succeed at both. Its AI agents audit your website, docs, GitHub, and community content to find what AI misunderstands or can't implement. Then they prioritize gaps, write code-grounded fixes as pull requests your team approves, and retest AI responses to measure what improved.

items.name: Versine
items.tagline: Let your AI send and receive money. We're Venmo for agents.
items.description: Send and receive money with AI. Connect it to ChatGPT, Claude, Instinct, Muse, or your own agent through our MCP. Recipients don’t need a Versine account: they can cash out straight to their bank. Each transfer is approved by your passkey or sent autonomously to trusted contacts that you set.

items.name: superlog
items.tagline: Finds the production bugs your monitoring never sees
items.description: Your monitoring only alerts on what you told it to watch, so customers still report bugs. Superlog finds the errors nobody set an alert for, investigates them 24/7 and hands you a fix. 100+ startups use it; 87% of our fixes get merged.

items.name: VINC
items.tagline: Bring your filmmaking vision to life.
items.description: You know the scene, the mood, the camera movement, and how your film should feel. VINC helps you work on the rest. Develop your script, sketch your storyboard, plan and generate your shots, with room to review and refine at every stage. Finally, bring all your generated shots into the built-in editor, where SFX and BGM are taken care of, and deliver your final output.

items.name: seshka
items.tagline: Kill what Claude Code left behind
items.description: Claude Code sessions end. The dev servers, watchers and scripts they started don't. seshka shows them in your menu bar, grouped by session, with memory and ports. Kill them in one click. End idle sessions too, by hand or automatically. Free and open source.

items.name: Superhands
items.tagline: Design the system, not every output.
items.description: Design’s deliverable is now the system, not the output. Turn your designs into guidance that agents follow in every AI tool your team uses. See what they produce, and fix the system once instead of chasing every output.

items.name: Ridian
items.tagline: The AI-first scheduling suite for everything around meetings
items.description: Ridian is an AI-first scheduling suite. Booking pages with payments, waitlists, groups and teams. Funnels that ask the right questions and send every lead to the right call. A built-in CRM where every booking and funnel answer lands. Calendar and contact sync across Google, Microsoft, iCloud and more. Connect all your calendars and inboxes and let Claude, ChatGPT or Alvin handle it out of the box. You can even give your agents their own mailbox. Everything around your meetings, handled.

items.name: Link.bio
items.tagline: Paste your link, we build your page that your AI runs
items.description: Paste your link, we build your personalized link in bio page — and your agent runs it. 1. Paste your Instagram, TikTok, YouTube or site. 2. AI writes your bio, buttons and theme in seconds. 3. Tweak it, or just ask ChatGPT or Claude. 4. Share your link.bio.

items.name: Clamor
items.tagline: Turns social signals into actionable insights
items.description: Social data tells you what's happening. Clamor helps you understand why it matters and what to do next. Built by marketers for marketers, Clamor turns social signals into actionable insights. Now it's even easier to: 🔍 Analyze public social accounts without a login 🔮 Explore insights with Ask Clamor, anywhere 💨 Find answers faster with a simpler experience 🛠️ Integrate insights into your tools via API Less time collecting data. More time making smarter decisions. Try the new Clamor today!

items.name: Glass Page
items.tagline: A place for people to review an agent's work
items.description: I built Glass Page after my agent wrote a system design doc that I wanted my team to comment on. Now Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Codex or any agent on MCP can publish what it makes as a Pane with a link. A Canvas lays the Pages out on that link so you can pan and zoom. Your team leaves Comments in Threads, on the exact spot. The agent reads them and replies with a new Version, and one Latest Link always shows the current one. Free for up to 10 Panes.

items.name: AI Visibility by TruLata
items.tagline: Find out if ChatGPT names your business when buyers ask
items.description: Buyers now ask ChatGPT, Gemini and Claude who to hire, and take the answer. Type your website and in about ten seconds see whether AI engines can read it, with every fix spelled out and no email needed. Then watch the engines answer six real buyer questions. Inside TruLata the check runs every week across nine engines, and a blank answer is never scored as a miss.

items.name: Pinecall
items.tagline: The open-source platform for voice AI agents
items.description: Voice agents you can prove. Pinecall is the open-source platform for voice apps: build in a form, in code, or from your AI assistant over MCP. Test with simulated callers, get every call logged and judged, and keep a person one tap away. On our cloud or your own Kubernetes. Apache-2.0, built on LiveKit.

items.name: Lasso
items.tagline: Draw on your Mac screen, then let AI agents see it
items.description: Lasso lets you draw arrows, boxes and notes right on your Mac screen with ⌥⇧A, then press S to screenshot what you marked up. Blur sensitive bits, share an encrypted link that expires in 24 hours, or sketch on an endless whiteboard. It also runs a local MCP server, so Claude Code, Cursor and Claude Desktop can see what you circled and draw back. $9.99 once, no account, no subscription. macOS 14+, Apple silicon and Intel.

items.name: Agents API by Recall.ai
items.tagline: Send your agent to meetings
items.description: Send your AI agent into Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, and Webex calls. It hears everyone live, talks back, shows up on camera, shares its screen, and posts in chat. Build your agent with any model or voice stack. One API call sends it in the meeting.

items.name: pushr
items.tagline: iPhone push alerts from any script, server or AI agent
items.description: Send a push to your iPhone from any script, server, cron job or AI agent with one HTTP request. No SDK. Orders, payouts, deploys and outages land in one feed, each with its own logo and color. Live Activities for long jobs, replies from the Lock Screen, alarms that ring until you acknowledge them, plus uptime and heartbeat monitors. Free plan, Pro when you need more. The backend is open source (MIT) and self-hostable.

items.name: Liquid d1.2
items.tagline: Decision models that return calibrated probabilities
items.description: Liquid d1.2 and d1.2-ultra are omnimodal decision models that return calibrated probabilities, so low-confidence answers can go to human review. This version adds audio input and five tasks: reading values, finding text spans, locating objects, estimating numbers with a range, and multi-select. Per Liquid AI, d1.2-ultra scores 75 on the Artificial Analysis Decision Index, two points above the previous best. On the Liquid API now; OpenRouter and Vercel coming soon.
